name: reshape
note: THE CONFIGURATION THAT HAS NEVER BEEN RUN. Everything measured so far -- ours 70.67 vs EEGNet 72.26, a tie at p=0.70 corrected -- was measured on the trunk's PUBLISHED SHAPE: pool hops by 1, so attention receives 690 tokens whose adjacent cosine is 0.987, i.e. a ~99% redundant sequence. Every architecture that beats this trunk hands its attention 13-61 tokens (ATCNet 13, CTNet 15, MSVTNet 18, Conformer 61). The trunk is also depth-1 per branch where all of them are deeper. Those two facts are one change: decimating the trunk is what makes depth and real attention affordable. This sweep walks from the current shape to that shape ONE FACTOR AT A TIME so a regression is attributable, which the prior harness never did -- it changed several at once and got +0.04. Verified [here] that the chain builds and produces the intended token counts: 565 -> 74 (pool_stride 8) -> 10 (stage-2 k15/pool7). NOTE the honest prior against enthusiasm: attention was measured at -6.79 (p=0.0117) on 288 trials and only mildly positive (+0.55, 5/10, p=0.68) at 52 subjects, ALWAYS on 690 tokens. It has never once been given a short sequence. That is the untested hypothesis, not 'transformers are good'.

arms.name: base
arms.prediction: the published shape, 565 tokens. Already measured at 70.67; re-run here so the ladder is internally paired rather than cross-referenced.

arms.name: decim
arms.prediction: 565 -> 74 tokens. Tests the redundancy finding directly. If accuracy is FLAT, ~87% of the trunk's output was duplicate and everything below becomes affordable. If it drops materially, the sliding pool was doing real work and the ladder stops here.

arms.name: deep
arms.prediction: 74 -> 10 tokens, plus the second depthwise temporal stage every architecture that beats us has and we lack. +1 to +2.5 over decim. Depthwise on purpose, so feature_channel_index stays exact.

arms.name: deep_attn
arms.prediction: THE ARM THIS SWEEP EXISTS FOR. Identical to `deep` with the gated attention block ON, over 10 tokens instead of 690. Attention has never been given a sequence short enough to be worth its parameter count. If the -6.79 and +0.55 results were about sequence length rather than about attention, this is where it shows. Falsified if it lands at or below `deep`.

arms.name: deep_ms
arms.prediction: the full MSVTNet-shaped trunk: 4 explicit scales, normalization, decimation, depth. Multi-scale alone was -0.47 on the UNDECIMATED shape; the question is whether it pays once the sequence is short.

arms.name: deep_ms_attn
arms.prediction: everything at once -- reported LAST and read only against deep_ms, never against base, because a combination arm cannot attribute anything on its own.

arms.name: msvtnet
arms.prediction: the architecture we are imitating, in-sweep so the ladder can be read without cross-referencing another results directory. It beat this trunk by +2.91 (10/10, p=0.0020) [prior].
